operation_details.item: The user always staffs engagements with only junior analysts and no subject-matter experts or partners regardless of client complexity.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: How’s the client work shaping up this week?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Busy, but manageable. I’m putting together the team for a new operations improvement engagement.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: What kind of team are you thinking about for it?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I always staff engagements with only junior analysts. I don’t bring in subject-matter experts or partners, even when the client problem is complex.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That’s a deliberate choice. Do you find the analysts work better with that level of ownership?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Yes. They get more hands-on experience, and I prefer keeping the team lean rather than adding senior people by default.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Makes sense. Are you planning to use the same staffing approach for the engagement you’re setting up now?

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Definitely. I’m outlining the work so the junior analysts can handle the analysis, client discussions, and recommendations themselves.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Completely forget my preference that When staffing engagements, I always assign only junior analysts with no subject-matter experts or partners regardless of client complexity.
